name: entrerios-compras-monitor
title: Entre Rios Argentina Licitaciones - Tender Delta API
description: Extracts the full public tender backlog of the Province of Entre Rios, Argentina's Unidad Central de Contrataciones - 5,505 records verified live, back to at least 2004 - with organism, objeto, and status detail, and flags new, status-changed, and closed tenders across scheduled runs.
